predeclared_gate.criterion: At u-selected checkpoints, actualgradient must reduce validation mean P1 error by >=30% relative to matchedzero, fixedTRAIN101_479 mean P1 error by >=50%, and increase validation u mean and worst by <=2 percentage points each.
predeclared_gate.if_pass: Repeat the same pair at seed2027 before spending another stress-training pair.
predeclared_gate.if_fail: Use the matched loss/physical metrics to diagnose whether derivative optimization fails or CAD transfer remains the bottleneck; choose one smallest next control. No automatic loss/width sweep.

checkpoint_selection: known-load validation mean physical u only; strain reports same selected checkpoint
interpretation: Development validation and training-u-derived P1 tensor proxy; no solver strain label, significance or final generalization claim.
